Name: Daily Mushroom Boxes
Author: NoisyFox
Description:
For the Mushroom Cave afficionado I present : Daily Mushroom Boxes! 

Tired of walking into your farm cave to see that there are no mushrooms ready for collection? This is a really straightforward Content Patcher mod to make your Mushroom Boxes produce every single day rather than every other day.

I was unaware that the previous daily production in 1.5 was unintended but now I miss it so I reverted it.

Manifest.Name: Daily Mushroom Boxes
Manifest.Description: Makes your mushroom boxes produce every day.
